_note: Names dropped by hand from EVERY list (the gate reads the lists together, so an exception of one language applies to all), each with its reason. Ordinary words that are also given names are KEPT (a missed name is the worse mistake); a name goes here only when it does real harm as a gate in a header such as 'Plan for X Y'. Keys are lower case; the language groups only say where a word was found.
